# lightpanda v0.3.3 - Table of Contents

Mix tasks for installing and invoking the Lightpanda headless browser (u2i fork build with cookie-on-WS-upgrade fix)

## Pages

- [Lightpanda](https://lightpanda.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://lightpanda.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Lightpanda](https://lightpanda.hexdocs.pm/Lightpanda.md): Lightpanda is an installer and runner for the
[Lightpanda](https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser) headless browser.
- [Lightpanda.Server](https://lightpanda.hexdocs.pm/Lightpanda.Server.md): A GenServer that manages a Lightpanda browser process.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix lightpanda](https://lightpanda.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Lightpanda.md): Invokes lightpanda with the given profile and args.
- [mix lightpanda.install](https://lightpanda.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Lightpanda.Install.md): Installs the Lightpanda binary.
